target.quantifiers: There exists one finite C such that for every n>=0 and every genuine Boolean sign f on the uniform n-cube, H(f)<=C I(f).

routes.proved_scope: regular functions; stated m-combinations; read-k/M compositions; product-biased symmetric thresholds; read-once threshold formulas
routes.first_open_implication: A dimension-independent-cost representation of every Boolean function in these classes, with all log m, log k, log M, label and overlap costs paid by O(I).
routes.circular_edge_rejected: Arbitrary Boolean functions are not declared regular or bounded-read by FEI itself.

routes.proved_scope: Variational witness reference bound for each admissible finite witness; addressing expected cost <10 I.
routes.first_open_implication: Uniform O(I) expected joint-witness cost for every Boolean function, retaining normalization, rank and sparse-root terms.
routes.circular_edge_rejected: Gibbs/reference coding alone does not bound expected description cost.

routes.proved_scope: If every Boolean f admits a complete admissible package with J_f<=K I(f), FEI holds with 2+K_ref+K.
routes.first_open_implication: Universal admissible construction and J_f<=K I(f).
routes.circular_edge_rejected: No converse is assumed; FEI cannot be used to pay J_f.

routes.proved_scope: C_FEI<=C_step<=C_FEI+2/ln2; same finiteness equivalence after restriction to critical tensor-prime descendants.
routes.first_open_implication: A direct finite bound on min_i Delta_iH/I_i for every restriction-critical tensor-prime Boolean function.
routes.circular_edge_rejected: The upper sandwich direction contains C_FEI and is not an independent bound.

routes.proved_scope: C_L<=C_FEI<=C_L+3/ln2 under complete Boolean autocorrelation constraints.
routes.first_open_implication: A universal Boolean bound L(f)<=K I(f), or a genuinely stronger existential/nonlocal refinement.
routes.circular_edge_rejected: Non-Boolean prefix laws show constraint insufficiency, not Boolean realizability; FEI cannot be imported to bound L.

routes.proved_scope: A seed-uniform additive-overhead conditional estimate for every arbitrary core and all tensor orders implies FEI by division by tensor order.
routes.first_open_implication: Prove such a conditional estimate without assuming FEI on the arbitrary core.
routes.circular_edge_rejected: Bounded fiber support is a restricted theorem and grows exponentially under arbitrary tensor cores.

new_normal_form.statement: Every nonconstant Boolean f has a restriction-critical tensor-prime descendant h with H(h)/I(h)>=H(f)/I(f); hence C_FEI is exactly the supremum on that class.
new_normal_form.movement: Eliminates noncritical restrictions and disjoint tensor products from the unresolved universal coordinate estimate without assuming FEI.

optimal_constant_warning: No equality of optimal constants among C_FEI, C_step, C_L, posterior residual slopes, or fixed-cyclic conditional slopes is claimed beyond the explicit sandwiches.
